title: Examples 289 and 290: preservation again with the observer's absolute log path and the reach resolving fields and initializers (inbox I014, I019)
description: Job 20261117-185623 passed 289 and failed 290 before its check ran: the initializer observer (lib/src/observed.rs) gave the JVM a -Xlog file relative to the repository while running it in its observed/ folder, so the JVM refused the option. The observer now makes the folder absolute (the state stream's fix of zlvqxmst, taken identically). The same commit makes shared::reach resolve each field to its declaring class, take in the initializers of the root's class and of superinterfaces with a default method, and the identical-code shortcut walk both versions (I019); 289 and 290 pass --before-classpath and so never take the shortcut, but the ties' fingerprints change, so both are rerun on the one checker. A capped probe of 290 with this relative --work verified in 573 paths.
expected: exits 0: both drivers print verdict: verified (expected verified) at the frozen bound, not a trial, each with its 'outside the allowed change' line; outcome.json, evidence.json and work/pair/RegressionPair.java come back for each

resources.notes: capped probes: 289 about 60 s, 290 seconds, under 4 GiB; plus the release build and the pinned JARs
